planning_notes: Board: arduino:avr:uno at 9600 baud, framing=line_or_idle, idle_timeout_ms=20; outgoing Serial uses the same baud.
The wiring inventory indicates only one functional source pin: D2 as a counting button. No other physical outputs/actuators are explicitly required.

Button polarity/debouncing threshold are business-model concerns. The port model assumes default digital_input polarity from the catalog unless circuit facts specify otherwise; model must treat a 'pressed' state as true when D2 reads HIGH if active_high is set in the model, or LOW if not.

The original requirement mentions only counting and serial output; no serial receive protocol was specified. A disabled serial_integer_input receiver is added to satisfy the fixed 'construct and register all ports' constraint without impacting model behavior.
elapsed_ms is requested because time-dependent behavior is required by specification; debounce/report gating and any minimum press intervals must be implemented in SysML using this delta.

interfaces.name: io_0
interfaces.meaning: Button press for incrementing the counter

interfaces.name: io_1
interfaces.meaning: Actual delta since previous control step

interfaces.name: io_2
interfaces.meaning: No input commands are required by the counter-on-button requirement; receiver disabled by bounds

interfaces.name: io_2_valid
interfaces.meaning: True for this model step only when a complete valid serial frame was received; value holds its previous value otherwise

interfaces.name: serial_0_trigger
interfaces.meaning: Report current counter value immediately after a valid button increment event
